newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE SLAMS THE HOLE THAT SEVE DESIGNED.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE SLAMS THE HOLE THAT SEVE DESIGNED.

text.p: The Seve Ballesteros-designed 17th at Valderrama was slammed as "the worst we have played all year" by European number one Colin Montgomerie on Sunday.
"It makes the golf course a lottery," said Montgomerie after a final round of 75 in the Volvo Masters. The same hole was criticised by other players on Saturday.
"The Ryder Cup next year could be decided at that hole and it should not happen on a hole like that," said Montgomerie, European number one for the fourth consecutive year.
The 511-yard 17th is characterised by large humps on the landing area of the fairway, a patch of rough across the fairway and a steep slope in front of the green sloping down into a lake.
After a good drive downwind, Montgomerie struck a seven-iron second shot to the green.
"It pitched six feet on to the green and spun back into the lake...a seven iron flier from the rough. Can you believe that? It's just not on," he said.
"Seve Ballesteros may be the best golfer who ever lived but he's no course architect."
Montgomerie salvaged his par five by pitching to six feet and making the putt.
"We should start again with that hole. The whole thing is wrong, the bumps in the fairway are wrong, the rough is wrong, the green is wrong," he said.
"...since they changed the 17th hole the course is gone for me. Seventeen great holes and this one. It is totally out of character with every other hole on the course."
Course owner Jaime Ortiz Patino said on Saturday he would make any changes to the hole that Ballesteros requested. But so far Ballesteros had given no indication he was unhappy with it.
